how_these_were_written: Phrasings an operator actually types, written before the description was widened rather than copied out of it. Two of them failed at first: 'sign off' and 'waiting on me' were absent from the description, which is the defect this file exists to find. The near-misses share real vocabulary with the description on purpose — a contrast that scores zero proves nothing. The machine-decidable one is marked non-lexical: 'decide which retry limit' and 'what should I decide' are the same word, and what separates them is who must decide, which is meaning and not vocabulary.
